Case note: O.S. No. 2855/2023
Client: Gayatri Menon (hardware dealer, Lucknow)
Opposing party: Naveen Kulkarni
Court: Lucknow District Court
Filed on: 24/07/2023
Claim amount: 58 lakh rupees
Issue: land dispute. The neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot.
Advice given: Apply for a court commissioner to measure the boundary.
Outcome: The court commissioner confirmed the encroachment.
Recommended next step: Seek removal of the encroachment.
